verdict.rationale: YYLO's own `yy skills` tooling applies updates only when explicitly run, selecting the latest compatible stable release. Skills are independently versioned. Differing or customized copies are flagged for review rather than silently overwritten. However, no evidence shows pinning a specific version or a shared lockfile that holds a team on a chosen release. Missing for 10: documented version pinning, a team-shareable lockfile or manifest, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates

citations.quote: Run `yy skills install` or `yy skills update` explicitly to select the latest compatible stable release and update all three agent copies.
differing customized/unrecorded copies require review. Unrecorded legacy copies remain preserved and flagged, not silently deleted.
Seven independently versioned Skills help agents use Ledger Records, understand projects, plan work, and deliver one bounded task.
This repository is the canonical, independently versioned source for skills used by YYLO CLI, YYLO Ledger and YYLO Benchmark.
